blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.41-19666 on July 30, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (4b1cce4a13365c238a208504affdee8f4b63caaa8fe0505abe294a0972d761da) and records an archive size of 36844395 bytes, approximately 36.8 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
